name: get_fire_footprint_kml_links
title: Get FIRMS fire footprint KML links
description:
Download links for FIRMS fire footprint files (KMZ, for Google Earth and GIS software) by region and period (24h, 48h, 72h, 7d), one per sensor: MODIS (c6.1), VIIRS Suomi NPP, NOAA-20, NOAA-21, and Landsat (Canada and the contiguous USA + Hawaii only). The files show detection footprints colored by time since detection.

Regions: canada, alaska, usa_contiguous_and_hawaii, central_america, south_america, europe, northern_and_central_africa, southern_africa, russia_asia, south_asia, southeast_asia, australia_newzealand. Use it when the user wants files to open in GIS or Google Earth rather than numbers or a web map.

This tool does not need a FIRMS MAP_KEY, and neither do the files.
